name: 98642 · Ridgefield, WA
findings: ZIP 98642 (Ridgefield) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98642 (Ridgefield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98642 (Ridgefield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
